decisive_spans.text: biopsy specimens were negative for carcinoma but demonstrated amyloid protein deposition

response.rationale: The presence of amyloid protein deposition in biopsy specimens and a circumferential urethral mass strongly supports Primary Amyloidosis of the Urethra. While Urethral Stenosis is also present, the amyloid deposition points to the underlying cause.
